important_blocks.semantics: 五组 [f32;4] 与 WGSL 五组 vec4 静态同序，Debug 不参与上传。

important_blocks.name: screen_uv_and_radius

important_blocks.semantics: RGB 由八位辐照度转浮点，w 为解析权重（当前编码为 1）。

important_blocks.semantics: 层级辐照度/权重当前编码为零，shader 只有 w>0 才混入。

important_blocks.name: hierarchy_rt_lighting
important_blocks.semantics: RT RGB 来自同 probe ID 的 sideband，存在非零通道才设 0.75 权重。

important_blocks.name: temporal_signature_and_padding
important_blocks.semantics: x 历史签名、y 场景可信度、z 浮点来源 mask、w Q8 归一化动态权重；四项均被 shader 读取。

important_blocks.name: grading
important_blocks.semantics: color grading 的 exposure/contrast/saturation/gamma；中性 settings 与启用当前 settings 由 helper 区分。

important_blocks.name: tint_and_probe
important_blocks.semantics: 非负 tint RGB 与旧屏幕反射强度；当前 encoder 计数0使反射循环不进入。

important_blocks.semantics: 固定调色RGB与 GI permission且有probe时 .4 强度；没有有效probe时强度0。

important_blocks.semantics: baked helper 当前保持默认中性全屏贡献，旧开关不复活退役屏幕加成。

important_blocks.name: effect_dof_lens
important_blocks.semantics: focal mm/focus range/blade count/rotation，核进行焦外几何与 coverage。

important_blocks.name: effect_vignette_grain
important_blocks.semantics: vignette intensity/smoothness/roundness 与 grain intensity；sampling/frame noise 分支依它们执行。

important_blocks.name: effect_chromatic_fog
important_blocks.semantics: chromatic intensity/spread 与 fog density/height falloff；输入维度和相机深度仍由其他向量提供。

important_blocks.name: effect_fog_color
important_blocks.semantics: fog RGB 与 grain fog-response，color非负保护。

important_blocks.name: effect_dither_ssr
important_blocks.semantics: dither intensity/scale 和 SSR intensity/thickness；不是 SSR 单独资源可用性判定。

important_blocks.semantics: SSR max distance/max steps/temporal blend/mip bias，由独立 SSR 使用共享布局，主shader挂载仍保留同字段。

important_blocks.name: effect_depth

important_blocks.name: effect_projection
important_blocks.semantics: 非抖动 perspective focal xy 或 orthographic half-extents，重建需要与稳定 basis 配套。

important_blocks.name: effect_view_x

important_blocks.name: effect_view_y
important_blocks.semantics: camera本地Y世界基向量，finite且非零才保留，否则 canonical Y。

important_blocks.name: effect_view_z
important_blocks.semantics: camera本地Z世界基向量，finite且非零才保留，否则 canonical Z。

important_blocks.name: effect_motion_blur
important_blocks.semantics: shutter/samples/0/0；已经分拆执行时 execute 清前两项防止再次积分。

baked_color_lut_view: Option<&wgpu::TextureView>,

        exposure_buffer: wgpu::BufferBinding<'_>,
        frame: &ViewportRenderFrame,
        streamer: &ResourceStreamer,
        features: SceneRuntimeFeatureFlags,

    ) -> WgpuBufferUploadBatch {

            reflection_probe_count,
            hybrid_gi_probe_count,
            scheduled_trace_region_count,
            mut uploads,

            self,

            viewport_size,
            features.reflection_probes_enabled,
            features.hybrid_global_illumination_enabled,

            local_viewport_size,
            cluster_dimensions,

            scene_color_origin,
            extract,
            frame.post_process(),
            features,
            temporal_history_available,

            reflection_probe_count,

important_blocks.name: deferred_lighting_enabled
important_blocks.semantics: 编译许可选择deferred场景pass和indirect mesh准备，material还需兼容deferred。

important_blocks.name: ssao_enabled
important_blocks.semantics: 向PostProcess feature_flags.x编码，不等同contact shadow权限。

important_blocks.name: contact_shadow_enabled
important_blocks.semantics: 独立向lighting_flags.x编码，shader乘入独立contact因子。

important_blocks.name: clustered_lighting_enabled
important_blocks.semantics: 控制GPU二维聚合生成，最终旧全屏cluster补色仍被builder置0。

important_blocks.name: hybrid_global_illumination_enabled
important_blocks.semantics: 控制prepared probe/trace编码及GI历史请求；current lighting/history可用还分别检查。

important_blocks.name: temporal_history_enabled
important_blocks.semantics: 普通temporal/SSR历史许可，不代表GI历史；准备图还要求模式、输出可写及资源存在。

important_blocks.name: bloom_enabled
important_blocks.semantics: record绑定传入execute的permission；阈值/intensity/资源视图仍需当前有效。

important_blocks.name: color_grading_enabled
important_blocks.semantics: helper选择当前color settings或默认中性参数。

important_blocks.name: anti_alias_enabled
important_blocks.semantics: 通用builder的Fxaa开关仍和实际AA模式相与，终端阶段另选pipeline。

important_blocks.name: reflection_probes_enabled
important_blocks.semantics: 旧屏幕编码入口接收许可但返回0；环境世界探针不借此结构混同。

important_blocks.name: baked_lighting_enabled
important_blocks.semantics: 编译许可保留；退役全屏baked helper两分支都返回默认中性。

important_blocks.name: sprite_rendering_enabled
important_blocks.semantics: 准备mesh时决定sprite draw列表与统计，场景pass还检查descriptor挂载。

important_blocks.name: particle_rendering_enabled
important_blocks.semantics: mapper复制particle capability；已读named-plugin/descriptor-only测试。未把导航命中声称完整执行body覆盖。

important_blocks.name: virtual_geometry_enabled
important_blocks.semantics: 作为真实参数传给mesh draw准备，功能许可仍需下层具体draw资源。

objects.name: SceneRuntimeFeatureFlags
objects.preconditions: mapper从已编译pipeline取得runtime_feature_flags并逐字段复制；permission不替代当帧settings/resource checks，Default全false。

objects.state_change: 类型声明无状态机；mapper产生Copy快照，执行入口分别与当前有效资源/模式/count结合。
